scope: Official Chinese municipal cadastral/property-map data portals for Shanghai, Beijing and Tianjin; distinguish title/cadastre parcels from planning plots, land-sale lots and buildings.
method: Reviewed the existing bounded research records dated 2026-09-28/29, then checked official portal/policy pages and search-indexed metadata. No personal login, private owner attributes, or parcel polygon records were accessed or persisted. Direct official-host requests that failed are recorded as client reachability failures, not absence. No tiny-bbox query was run because no anonymous cadastral vector endpoint was identified.

cities.officialDataExists: Yes: official cadastral-map query and map-based real-estate/property inquiry are documented.
cities.openVectorOrAnonymousQueryApi: Not verified. The official cadastral-map entry leads to an account-oriented registration service; the one-map property query is interactive/building-based and is not a documented bulk parcel feed. Shanghai open-data direct request returned HTTP 412 anti-automation response; this does not establish absence.
cities.falsePositiveChecked: Shanghai Tianditu public Detailed Plan Map exposes ArcGIS/GeoScene planblock and planscopeline planning layers with plot/permit/planning fields; these are planning polygons/lines, not cadastral title boundaries. Tokenless ArcGIS metadata requests failed from this client; not queried for features.
cities.nextStep: Use an authorized account on the bureau-linked cadastral service or obtain an official catalog answer confirming whether a parcel geometry product is available; test its documented metadata/bounded endpoint and check coverage and native parcel ID.

cities.officialDataExists: Yes: the 2022-05-17 Chinese municipal announcement offers an individual visual lookup of registered buildings and their cadastral map; any person/entity can use it after authenticated login.
cities.openVectorOrAnonymousQueryApi: Not verified. The current Chinese notice is explicit about a visual, selected-building query through an identity-verified portal. No anonymous bulk polygon service or downloadable parcel feed was found. Direct portal/data-site requests from this client failed.
cities.falsePositiveChecked: Public Tianditu base-map/service catalog did not establish a cadastral polygon layer; base maps are not parcel title data.
cities.nextStep: Check the authenticated portal/catalog for a documented geometry-bearing dataset or bounded feature endpoint, its coverage and stable native parcel identifier; do not infer that the visual query exposes bulk vectors.

cities.officialDataExists: Registration/cadastral holdings are supported by an official search-indexed budget-document excerpt; full PDF context was not inspected. The official Tianditu handbook also lists real-property registration in a results catalogue, without a specific parcel dataset. Public development-plot maps are not title cadastre.
cities.openVectorOrAnonymousQueryApi: Not verified. Tianjin Tianditu's official handbook says the results catalog covers thematic data including 不动产登记 and supports metadata/coverage/update inspection and download applications, some requiring approval. It does not name a parcel-boundary dataset, provide a public feature service or confirm downloadable geometry. Tianjin open-data portal is live, but category/keyword searches did not surface a cadastre layer; catalog search is bounded, not exhaustive. The portal's normal map/developer resources and documented data APIs require identity/key and describe generic base maps/structured data; no parcel feature endpoint identified.
cities.falsePositiveChecked: Tianjin 土地码/码上看地 presents about 95 mature, tradeable development parcels with planning/investment information; treat these as project/land-sale lots, not cadastral coverage. Tianditu base vector maps/tiles are roads/water/settlements, not cadastre.
cities.nextStep: Follow Tianjin Tianditu 成果目录's 不动产登记 category and request the actual dataset metadata/product specification: boundary geometry, coverage, native parcel ID, update cadence, delivery format and access/approval. Then test a bounded metadata or sample query after confirming its technical access requirements.

overall: No anonymous cadastral polygon endpoint was verified for any of the three cities in this bounded pass. This does not show that cadastral records are absent. Integration research can continue against an identified geometry-bearing source, its technical query/authentication model, coverage and stable native key; terms are informational and are not a stop condition.
